featured.title: Chronos-2: A foundation model for multivariate time series forecasting
featured.tldr: Chronos-2 is a 120M-parameter zero-shot forecaster that uses group attention to learn relationships among related series and covariates in context, trained only on synthetic multivariate data.

featured.title: Learning the 4D World through Point Trajectory Forecasting
featured.tldr: Training a multi-view video world model to also forecast where tracked 3D points will move yields more faithful futures than a video-only twin and higher robot success rates.
